status: User-specified scenario: approved legitimate payments earn 25% of Amount, approved fraud loses 100%, and cancellation has zero direct profit or loss.
units: Same monetary units as source Amount; no conversion assumed.
tie_policy: Approve at exactly zero expected profit; at zero Amount either action has zero profit and approval is used.
limitations: No challenge fees, review costs, abandonment, recovery or chargeback fees are included.
Economics are assumed, not observed outcomes; review/challenge policies are deferred.
